fusions.name: Browsing Mouthfuls
fusions.desc: Tears 3 mouthfuls from the enemies ahead at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Course
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Swallows it for 22 damage and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Seagrass Banquet
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Fattened by Degrees
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
